question.q: Which sentence means 'Hardly any students missed the meeting'?
question.correct: Almost all students attended the meeting.
wrong: Almost all students missed the meeting.
No one knew a meeting had been scheduled.
The meeting was canceled before anyone arrived.
question.exp: Hardly any ... missed 等於幾乎沒有人缺席，因此幾乎全部到場。

question.q: Which sentence best matches 'The bridge will not open until the safety inspection is complete'?
question.correct: The bridge will remain closed before the inspection is finished.
wrong: The bridge will open before the inspection begins.
The inspection can only happen after the bridge opens.
The bridge has already been open for months.
question.exp: not ... until 表在檢驗完成前不開放，不能誤解為立即開放。

question.q: Which sentence is closest in meaning to 'Not all students supported the proposed schedule change'?
question.correct: Some students did not support the proposed schedule change.
wrong: No student supported the proposed schedule change.
Every student rejected the proposed schedule change.
Most students supported the change, and no one disagreed.
question.exp: 'Not all' negates a universal claim: at least one student did not support the change. It does not imply that nobody supported it.
question.subject: 英文

question.q: What does this statement mean? 'Unless the safety inspection is completed, the laboratory will remain closed.'
question.correct: The laboratory cannot reopen before the safety inspection is completed.
wrong: The laboratory must reopen before the inspection begins.
The laboratory will certainly open immediately after the inspection, regardless of its result.
The laboratory can reopen without any inspection if students request it.
question.exp: Unless expresses a necessary condition: no completed inspection means the laboratory stays closed. It does not guarantee reopening the moment the inspection finishes.
question.subject: 英文

question.q: Which statement most accurately restates 'Few residents opposed the new recycling rules'?
question.correct: Only a small number of residents expressed opposition.
wrong: Almost every resident actively opposed the rules.
All residents openly supported the rules.
No resident had an opinion about the rules.
question.exp: 'Few residents opposed' means the number who were against the rules was small. It does not specify how many actively supported or remained neutral.
question.subject: 英文
